chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr from al-Qasim from Jarrah al-Mad'ini from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That he disliked that a man should stay with another man while he has a debt upon him, even if he weighs it for him for only three days.

key_terms.يَنْزِلَ: to stay/reside (in a specific place or with a person)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on a creditor staying with a debtor who owes him money?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises against a creditor lodging with his debtor to ensure the debt is not forgotten or delayed, even for a brief period of three days. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on preserving social harmony and preventing the subtle friction that arises when financial obligations linger, ensuring the debtor feels no undue pressure or neglect.
